elements.element: Expiry or termination triggers Vendor's transition-assistance obligation without an additional condition.
elements.evidence: Although the clause begins with expiry or termination, subsection (a) makes assistance conditional on Customer's request, an additional trigger not stated in the preferred position.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for up to 6 months.
elements.evidence: Subsection (a) expressly provides reasonable transition assistance for up to six months.

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Subsection (a) expressly states that assistance is provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
Subsection (b) permits Vendor either to return the data or merely make it available for Customer extraction, so Vendor is not unconditionally required to perform the return.

elements.element: The Customer Data return deadline is 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The 30-day period runs from Customer's request, not from expiry or termination. A delayed or absent request can defer the return indefinitely.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Subsection (b) requires a commonly used, machine-readable format, which satisfies the standard machine-readable format requirement.

elements.element: Vendor deletes Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) requires deletion thereafter but expressly excludes data in routine backups and data retained for legal requirements; the preferred position contains no such qualification.

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion after the Customer Data return.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) requires Vendor to certify the deletion in writing thereafter.

elements.element: Expiry or termination triggers Vendor's transition-assistance obligation without an additional condition.
elements.evidence: Subsection (a) conditions assistance on Customer's request rather than making expiry or termination alone sufficient to trigger the obligation.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: Assistance for up to six months encompasses the requested 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: Vendor provides or enables export of Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Subsection (b) requires Vendor to return the data or make all Customer Data available for extraction.

elements.element: The data export deadline is 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The operative deadline is 30 days after Customer's request, not 30 days after expiry or termination.

result.reason: Neither level is complete. Most substantive concepts are included, but the operative language adds a Customer-request trigger and measures the data-export deadline from that request rather than from expiry or termination. It also permits extraction instead of requiring Vendor to return the data and qualifies deletion for backups and legal retention. The redline otherwise leaves the existing commercial terms effective and introduces no evident contradiction.
